I replied to Hollis in the DM thread to confirm that Caspian Halvorsen is now their go-to escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Nettle rollout.

I didn't save a separate brain fact. The brain already records this DM as a fact that only Hollis can see. The remember tool doesn't say who can see what it saves, so adding one could have exposed Hollis's note to other members. No other action was needed.
